---
title: "Beer"
output: html_document
date: "2025-12-10"
---
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(cluster)     # silhouette
library(factoextra)  # fviz_cluster, fviz_nbclust

# 파일 경로는 본인 환경에 맞게 수정

beer <- read_csv("C:/Users/USER/Downloads/beers3.csv")

glimpse(beer)
summary(beer)
table(beer$country)

# rownames 로 쓰기 위해 data.frame 으로 변환

beer_df <- as.data.frame(beer)

rownames(beer_df) <- beer_df$pname

# 분석에 사용할 변수만 추출

X <- beer_df[, c("cal", "sod", "alc", "cost")]

# NA 제거(있으면)

X <- na.omit(X)

# 표준화 (평균 0, 분산 1)

Z <- scale(X)
Z <- as.data.frame(Z)

head(Z)

# 유클리드 거리

DZ <- dist(Z)

# Ward.D2 방법

hc_ward <- hclust(DZ, method = "ward.D2")

plot(hc_ward, hang = -1, main = "Dendrogram (Ward.D2)")
rect.hclust(hc_ward, k = 3, border = 2:4)   #여기서는 k=3 예시

# 3개 군집으로 cut

k_hc <- cutree(hc_ward, k = 3)
table(k_hc)

# 실루엣 계수

Sil_hc <- silhouette(k_hc, DZ)
summary(Sil_hc)
plot(Sil_hc, border = NA)

fviz_nbclust(Z, kmeans, method = "wss") +
labs(title = "Elbow Method for k")

set.seed(1234)
km3 <- kmeans(Z, centers = 3, nstart = 20)

km3$size        # 군집 크기
km3$centers     # 표준화된 변수 기준 군집평균

# 레이블

k_km <- km3$cluster
table(k_km)

fviz_cluster(km3, data = Z,
ellipse.type = "euclid",
star.plot   = TRUE,
repel       = TRUE) +
labs(title = "K-means Clustering (k=3)")

Sil_km <- silhouette(k_km, DZ)
summary(Sil_km)
plot(Sil_km, border = NA)

beer_cluster <- beer_df %>%
mutate(cluster = factor(k_km))

head(beer_cluster)
table(beer_cluster$cluster)

beer_cluster %>%
group_by(cluster) %>%
summarise(
n    = n(),
cal  = mean(cal),
sod  = mean(sod),
alc  = mean(alc),
cost = mean(cost)
)

beer_cluster %>%
count(cluster, country) %>%
arrange(cluster, desc(n))

beer_long <- beer_cluster %>%
select(pname, cluster, cal, sod, alc, cost) %>%
pivot_longer(cols = c(cal, sod, alc, cost),
names_to = "variable",
values_to = "value")

ggplot(beer_long, aes(x = cluster, y = value, fill = cluster)) +
geom_boxplot() +
facet_wrap(~ variable, scales = "free_y") +
labs(title = "Cluster Profiles (Boxplots)",
x = "Cluster", y = "Value") +
theme_bw()

beer_cluster %>%
group_by(cluster) %>%
summarise(
cal  = mean(cal),
sod  = mean(sod),
alc  = mean(alc),
cost = mean(cost)
)
```
